name: thingsboard-rpc-oneway
notes: Run with: python3 evicon_review.py measure thingsboard (release 068: ThingsBoard is installed with demo data, the demo passwords are replaced by random ones, the device evicon-tb-1 is created and its token handed to the reference device in its environment). Persistent oneway RPC with expirationTime = send + 60 s; P7 keeps the device offline 90 s (longer than the expiry). Measured locally against ThingsBoard CE 4.3.1.6 (expiry 10 s, offline 20 s) before release: Q_A by listing the device's RPCs, T observed, D_h contradicted.
fault_model: network loss/delay, client abandon; owner up (no owner crash or reboot)
